claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item

claude_proposed_widenings.name: resource_free_activation

claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation_precondition

claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.form_zero_hp

claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed."
